entities.summary: Hassan Abbasi is an Iranian theorist and an Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps officer who heads its think-tank 'Center for Borderless Security Doctrinal Analysis'. Abbasi is primarily known for his theories, and for delivering controversial speeches on issues including economics, history, politics and cinema.
